text:
Anna Li: heads-up, onboarding bronte9b-int4. smoke canary shows recurring OOMs on a subset of hosts when batch_size=8 and max_new_tokens=256. logs point at slab fragmentation rather than steady leak.
Sam Ortiz: any repro steps? which config exactly?
Anna Li: repro snippet: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"bronte9b-int4","inputs":"summarize: ...","max_new_tokens":256,"batch_size":8}' 
```
Anna Li: stack dump excerpt: "OOM at allocate_slab(0x7f8...): available 12MB, requested 48MB; free_chunks high count but not contiguous"
Jia Chen: sounds like small-fragmentation - slots are free but non-contiguous. two quick mitigations: lower default max_new_tokens to 128 and switch canary to `slot_compact=true` (soft compaction between requests).
Miguel Rivera: we saw similar with pavo11b. microbatching to batch_size=4 + slight increase in prefetched slots helped. try batch_size 4 and set `kv_prefetch=false` for the canary.
Sam Ortiz: curious about perf hit. any latency numbers?
Anna Li: canary results after tweaks: batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=128, slot_compact=true, kv_prefetch=false. OOMs down from 37/day -> 3/day; p50 latency +6ms, p95 +28ms (within SLO). token throughput down ~8%.
ops-bot: deploy-canary bronte9b-int4 cfg=v2-slotcompact by anna-li succeeded on 6/8 hosts :rocket:
Sam Ortiz: ok that's promising. plan? rollout cadence?
Anna Li: propose staged rollout: 10% immediate, 30% after 2h if OOMs <5, full after 24h. will open RED-3421 with config diff and perf graphs.
Jia Chen: also add an alert: `slab_free_ratio < 0.2` for 5m to catch regressions; include per-host histograms so we don't get noisy agg alerts.
Miguel Rivera: add reproducer script to repo: `scripts/onboard/bronite-smoke.sh` (small load generator + pinned seed). I pushed a WIP to my fork.
Anna Li: thanks — I'll create the PR, include baseline perf, the canary logs, and the rollback plan. tagging @infra on RED-3421 for kernel slab metrics access.
Sam Ortiz: +1. once PR is up I'll coordinate the rollout window with support.
Anna Li: :thumbsup: closing loop here, will post PR link and a short postmortem if anything flares up during rollout.
Jia Chen: one more note — long term we should add a compact-on-evict heuristic to the runtime, maybe adaptive based on fragmentation ratio. filing a separate RFC.
Anna Li: agreed, filing RFC after this stabilizes.
